sales.t_order.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales.t_order ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT GEN_RANDOM_UUID () PRIMARY KEY, created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW (), updated_by VARCHAR(64), updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, row_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK ( row_status IN ( 'ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'DELETED', 'LOCKED', 'ARCHIVED' ) ), user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES authen.m_user (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, shop_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES shop.m_shop (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, address_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES authen.t_user_address (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, ship_title VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, ship_address BYTEA NOT NULL, ship_city BYTEA NOT NULL, ship_state BYTEA NOT NULL, ship_postal_code BYTEA NOT NULL, ship_country BYTEA NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, total_price NUMERIC(16, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (total_price >= 0), total_discount NUMERIC(16, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (total_discount >= 0), total_tax NUMERIC(16, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (total_tax >= 0), total_shipping NUMERIC(16, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (total_shipping >= 0), total_amount NUMERIC(16, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (total_amount >= 0), expires_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK ( status IN ( 'PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'WAIT_PAYMENT', 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMED', 'REFUNDED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED' ) ), CONSTRAINT ck_t_order_total_amount_sum CHECK (total_amount = total_price - total_discount + total_tax + total_shipping) );
table_constraints: CONSTRAINT ck_t_order_total_amount_sum CHECK (total_amount = total_price - total_discount + total_tax + total_shipping)

sales.t_order_item.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales.t_order_item ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT GEN_RANDOM_UUID () PRIMARY KEY, created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW (), updated_by VARCHAR(64), updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, row_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK ( row_status IN ( 'ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'DELETED', 'LOCKED', 'ARCHIVED' ) ), order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sales.t_order (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, shop_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES shop.m_shop (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES product.m_product (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sku_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES product.m_product_sku (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (quantity > 0), price NUMERIC(16, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (price >= 0), discount NUMERIC(16, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (discount >= 0), total_price NUMERIC(16, 2) NOT NULL CHECK ( total_price >= 0 AND total_price = price * quantity ), gross_profit NUMERIC(16, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (gross_profit >= 0), shop_profit NUMERIC(16, 2), platform_profit NUMERIC(16, 2), lot_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES shop.t_shop_product_sku_lot (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, UNIQUE (order_id, product_id, sku_id) );

payment.t_payment.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payment.t_payment ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT GEN_RANDOM_UUID () PRIMARY KEY, created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW (), updated_by VARCHAR(64), updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, row_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK ( row_status IN ( 'ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'DELETED', 'LOCKED', 'ARCHIVED' ) ), order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sales.t_order (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'STRIPE' CHECK (provider IN ('STRIPE')), provider_payment_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, amount NUMERIC(16, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0), currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'THB' CHECK (currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'), shipping_method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK ( shipping_method IN ('STANDARD', 'EXPRESS', 'SAME_DAY') ), shipping_fee NUMERIC(16, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 CHECK (shipping_fee >= 0), status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK ( status IN ( 'PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED' ) ), payment_method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK ( payment_method IN ( 'CREDIT_CARD', 'PAYPAL', 'BANK_TRANSFER', 'CASH_ON_DELIVERY', 'THAI_QR' ) ), payment_name VARCHAR(64), transaction_code VARCHAR(64) UNIQUE, transaction_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, failure_code VARCHAR(64), failure_message VARCHAR(256), provider_refund_id VARCHAR(64) UNIQUE, refunded_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, refund_reason VARCHAR(256), CONSTRAINT ck_t_payment_paid_has_transaction_at CHECK ( status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'REFUNDED') OR transaction_at IS NOT NULL ), CONSTRAINT ck_t_payment_refund_details CHECK ( (status = 'REFUNDED') = (refunded_at IS NOT NULL) AND (refunded_at IS NULL) = (provider_refund_id IS NULL) ), CONSTRAINT ck_t_payment_failure_only_when_failed CHECK ( (failure_code IS NULL AND failure_message IS NULL) OR status = 'FAILED' ) );
table_constraints:
CONSTRAINT ck_t_payment_paid_has_transaction_at CHECK (
            status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'REFUNDED')
            OR transaction_at IS NOT NULL
        )

CONSTRAINT ck_t_payment_refund_details CHECK (
            (status = 'REFUNDED') = (refunded_at IS NOT NULL)
            AND (refunded_at IS NULL) = (provider_refund_id IS NULL)
        )

CONSTRAINT ck_t_payment_failure_only_when_failed CHECK (
            (failure_code IS NULL AND failure_message IS NULL)
            OR status = 'FAILED'
        )
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_t_payment_order_id_live ON payment.t_payment (order_id) WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED') AND row_status = 'ACTIVE';

shipping.t_shipping.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shipping.t_shipping ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT GEN_RANDOM_UUID () PRIMARY KEY, created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW (), updated_by VARCHAR(64), updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, row_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK ( row_status IN ( 'ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'DELETED', 'LOCKED', 'ARCHIVED' ) ), order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sales.t_order (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, shipping_method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK ( shipping_method IN ('STANDARD', 'EXPRESS', 'SAME_DAY') ), status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK ( status IN ( 'PENDING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED', 'RETURNED' ) ), carrier_name VARCHAR(64), tracking_number VARCHAR(64), shipped_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, delivered_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, CONSTRAINT ck_t_shipping_shipped_has_tracking CHECK ( status NOT IN ('SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'RETURNED') OR ( carrier_name IS NOT NULL AND tracking_number IS NOT NULL AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL ) ), CONSTRAINT ck_t_shipping_delivered_at CHECK ( (status = 'DELIVERED') = (delivered_at IS NOT NULL) ) );
table_constraints:
CONSTRAINT ck_t_shipping_shipped_has_tracking CHECK (
            status NOT IN ('SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'RETURNED')
            OR (
                carrier_name IS NOT NULL
                AND tracking_number IS NOT NULL
                AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL
            )
        )
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_t_shipping_carrier_name_tracking_number ON shipping.t_shipping (carrier_name, tracking_number) WHERE tracking_number IS NOT NULL AND row_status <> 'DELETED';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_t_shipping_shipped_at ON shipping.t_shipping (shipped_at) WHERE status = 'SHIPPED' AND row_status <> 'DELETED';
